answer: Harbor sybil-tax bond: every new identity pays a 45-credit tax into the vault. Each newcomer registers at the harbor, pays 45, and gets one receipt. Falcon auditors check the vault log each epoch; a missing or reused receipt burns the identity. 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 5,000. Rented receipts fail: each binds to one harbor berth, and reuse burns both. An honest agent pays 45 once.
